_meta.note: English translation of Sikax. Text in braces, such as {nom}, is replaced at display time: keep it unchanged.

accueil.texte: Draw a first body with the Body tool (B key), or open a ready-made mechanism from File → Examples.

action.adopter_configuration: Use the Displayed Position as Initial Configuration

aide_action.theme_sombre: Switch between the light and dark themes
aide_action.montrer_vitesses: Show the velocity vectors of the points
aide_action.montrer_trajectoires: Show the trajectory of every point
aide_action.outil_selection: Select an object; drag a point to change the geometry
aide_action.outil_manipuler: Move the mechanism while respecting its joints (initial configuration)
aide_action.outil_barre: Draw a body point by point
aide_action.outil_point: Add a point to the selected body, or to the frame
aide_action.outil_ponctuelle: Point-on-line: a point stays on a line (roller support)
aide_action.outil_moteur: Impose the motion of a revolute or prismatic joint
aide_action.pivots_automatiques: Create a revolute joint when a new body starts from an existing point
aide_action.lancer: Compute the study defined in the Study panel
aide_action.equilibre: Bring the mechanism to a stable equilibrium position
aide_action.adopter_configuration: The mechanism will start from the position shown in the animation
aide_action.exporter_resultats: Saves every computed quantity in an Excel workbook (.xlsx), with charts
aide_action.importer_photo: Shows a photo of a diagram under the mechanism, to trace over it at scale
aide_action.detecter_formes: Finds the lines and circles of the photo and turns them into bodies
aide_action.outil_cercle: Circle or disc: click the centre, then drag to the radius
aide_action.outil_engrenage: Gear: click a wheel with a revolute joint, then the second wheel or a rack
aide_action.outil_came: Cam-follower: click the cam circle, then the follower tip
aide_action.outil_etalonnage: Click two points of the photo whose real distance you know
aide_action.outil_photo: Drag the background photo to align it with the grid
aide_action.tutoriel: Animated guided tour of Sikax's tools
aide_action.cours: Course sheets: kinematics, statics, dynamics, torsors, gears…

contexte.motoriser: Add a motor to this joint
contexte.ajouter_point: Add a point to this body

selection.aide: Click to select. Drag a point or a joint to change the geometry. Wheel: zoom · hold right button: pan.

manipuler.aide: Drag a body: the mechanism follows while respecting its joints. The resulting position becomes the initial configuration.
manipuler.rien: Click a moving body to drag it.

barre.aide: Click to place the first point of the body.
barre.suite: Click to add a point · Enter, double-click or right-click to finish · Esc to cancel.

point.aide: Click to add a point to the selected body (to the frame if no body is selected).

liaison.aide_point: Click a point shared by two bodies: joint between them. Click the end of a bar: joint with the ground. Click a body then a second one: joint between them, points created automatically.
liaison.aide_axe: Click a point or a body and drag to set the axis (15° steps; Shift for any angle). On a single body, then click the second body.
liaison.aucun_point: No point here: place the joint on a point of a body.
liaison.bati_seul: This point belongs to the frame only: place the joint on a point of a moving body.
liaison.deja_liee: These two bodies are already connected here by “{nom}”.
liaison.aucun_solide: Click a body: a point, a bar or a disc.
liaison.second: Click the second body to join to “{nom}” · empty space: the ground · right click or Esc: cancel.
liaison.meme_solide: Click another body (or empty space for the ground).

force.aide: Click a point of a body then drag to set the direction and magnitude of the force (1 pixel = 1 N).
force.aucun_point: Click a point of a moving body to apply the force.

couple.aide: Click a moving body to apply a torque to it.

ressort.aide: Click the first attachment point of the spring.
ressort.second: Click the second attachment point, on another body.
ressort.meme_solide: The two attachment points must belong to two different bodies.

moteur.aide: Click a revolute or prismatic joint to motorise it.
moteur.aucune_liaison: Click a revolute or prismatic joint.
moteur.non_pilotable: The joint “{nom}” cannot be motorised: only revolute and prismatic joints can.

message.fermeture_impossible: The mechanism can no longer be assembled with this geometry: check the lengths.

cercle.aide: Click the centre of the circle, then drag to the radius. Placed on a point of a body, the circle is added to that body (eccentric cam); otherwise it becomes a new disc.
cercle.cree: Circle created. Add a revolute joint (at the centre, or at another point for an eccentric).

engrenage.aide: Click the first wheel (a body with a revolute joint), then the second wheel — or a rack guided by a prismatic joint.
engrenage.aucune_roue: Click a wheel: a disc or bar with a revolute joint.
engrenage.sans_pivot: “{nom}” has no revolute joint: first put a revolute joint at its centre.
engrenage.seconde: Click the wheel to mesh with “{nom}” (or a rack) · right click: cancel.
engrenage.impossible: Gear impossible: the second wheel needs a revolute joint, or must be a rack guided by a prismatic joint.
engrenage.cree: Gear created: Z₁ = {za}, Z₂ = {zb}. Adjust teeth, module, pressure angle and efficiency in the properties.

came.aide: Click the cam circle (a disc), then the follower tip.
came.aucun_cercle: Click a circle or disc: the cam.
came.poussoir: Click the follower tip (a point of another body) · right click: cancel.
came.aucun_poussoir: Click a point or bar of another body: the follower.
came.impossible: The follower cannot reach the cam: move it closer, or check its guide.
came.cree: Cam-follower contact created: choose knife-edge, roller or flat face in the properties.

etalonnage.aide: Calibration: click two points of the photo whose real distance you know (a dimension, a bar length).
etalonnage.second: Click the second point of the known length · Esc: cancel.
etalonnage.question: Real length between the two points ({unite}):
etalonnage.trop_court: The two points are too close: pick a longer length on the photo.
etalonnage.fait: Photo calibrated: the chosen length now measures {longueur}.
etalonnage.sans_photo: No background photo: first import a diagram photo (File → Import a photo).

photo.aide: Drag the background photo to place it. Esc: back to selection.

champ.angle_articulaire: Angle of B relative to A

solide.note_bati: The frame is fixed: it has no inertia and no position to set. Its points anchor the joints.

proprietes.barres_aide: Spreads the entered mass over the segments of the body, treated as thin uniform bars, then computes the centre of gravity and the moment of inertia.
proprietes.pose_note: This body is connected to others: move it with the Move tool or through the position of a joint.

point.note: Changing these coordinates changes the geometry of the body.

liaison.modele_aide: How the joint is built in space. It does not change the planar motion but sets the actual degree of static indeterminacy of the mechanism.
liaison.inverser_aide: The axis is attached to body A (currently “{a}”). Swapping attaches it to the other body.
liaison.position_aide: Changing this value moves the mechanism: it is one way to set the initial configuration.
liaison.inaccessible: The mechanism cannot reach this position.
liaison.motoriser: Add a motor to this joint
liaison.torseur: Action of {a} on {b}, at the joint point

action.expression_aide: A value may depend on time: for example 100*sin(2*pi*t).

moteur.relatif: Motion measured from the initial configuration
moteur.relatif_aide: Checked: the law gives the displacement from the starting position. Unchecked: the law gives the value of the angle or displacement directly.

proprietes.modification_refusee: Change refused: the mechanism cannot be assembled with this value.
proprietes.disque_aide: Puts G at the circle centre and takes J = m·R²/2 for the given mass.

engrenage.entraxe_different: The diagram's centre distance differs from the theoretical one: the wheels are not tangent. The ratio stays exact, but the drawing does not.
engrenage.ajuster_aide: Moves wheel B (and the axle carrying it) to the theoretical centre distance.
engrenage.ajustement_impossible: Adjustment impossible: wheel B or its axle cannot be moved.

came.note: The contact slides freely: the cam can make full turns. A negative normal force means the follower lifts off (add a return spring).

fond.note: Calibrate the scale with a known length, then trace the mechanism over it. The photo is saved in the project.

aide.uniformement_accelere: f(t) = initial position + initial velocity × t + ½ × acceleration × t²
aide.sinusoidale: f(t) = offset + amplitude × sin(2π × frequency × t + phase)
aide.trapeze: Constant acceleration, plateau at maximum velocity, then deceleration, over the requested travel.
aide.blocage: The joint is held at a fixed position: the motor provides the holding effort.
aide.expression: f(t) is given by a formula; velocity and acceleration are derived from it exactly.
aide.fonctions: Variable t (s). Constants: pi, e, g. Functions: sin, cos, tan, asin, acos, atan, exp, log, sqrt, abs, min, max, lisse(t, t0, t1), rampe(t, t0, t1), si(condition, a, b). Angles are in radians; rad(30) converts degrees.

description.statique: Equilibrium of the mechanism in the displayed configuration: joint wrenches and holding efforts of the motors, from the fundamental principle of statics.
description.cinematique: The motion is imposed by the motors. Positions, velocities and accelerations are computed, then the joint forces and the motor effort required.
description.dynamique: The motion is computed by integrating the fundamental principle of dynamics: the mechanism moves freely under the loads and gravity.

etude.inertie_aide: Checked: forces are computed from the fundamental principle of dynamics. Unchecked: quasi-static computation, inertia effects are neglected.
etude.equilibre_aide: Moves the mechanism to a stable equilibrium position under the applied loads.
etude.modele_modifie: The model was changed during the computation: results discarded. Run the study again.
etude.bilan: {type} study finished: {instants} instant(s) computed in {duree} s.
etude.equilibre_introuvable: No equilibrium position found from this configuration.
etude.configuration_adoptee: The position at t = {t} s is now the initial configuration.
etude.precision_aide: Relative tolerance of the integrator: 1e-8 by default; 1e-6 computes faster.

validation.detail: {nom}: Ic = {ic}, Ec = {d}γ = {ec}, rank = {rang}  →  m = Ic − rank = {m};  h = Ec − rank = {h}  (check: Is − Es + m = {is_} − {es} + {m}).
validation.aide_vide: Draw bodies and connect them with joints: the mobility m and the degree of static indeterminacy h appear here, computed from the joint graph.

moteurs.complet: {moteurs} motor(s) for {m} mobility(ies): the motion is fully imposed, a kinematic study is possible.
moteurs.structure: No mobility: the mechanism is a structure. Run a static study.
moteurs.libre: {moteurs} motor(s), {pilotees} driven mobility(ies), {libres} free mobility(ies). Add motors for a kinematic study, or run a dynamic study.

validation.liaison_hyperstatique: This joint belongs to a statically indeterminate loop.

colonne_aide.type: Type of the joint in the plane
colonne_aide.modele: Standard joint that builds this joint in space
colonne_aide.plan: Degrees of freedom and static unknowns of the joint in the plane (they add up to 3)
colonne_aide.espace: Degrees of freedom and static unknowns of the joint in space (they add up to 6)

avertissement.aucun_solide: The mechanism has no moving body.
avertissement.solides_flottants: Body(ies) not connected to the frame: {solides}.
avertissement.configuration_singuliere: Configuration close to a singularity (aligned points): mobility and indeterminacy may change there.
avertissement.moteurs_surabondants: {nombre} motor(s) too many: they impose more motions than the mechanism has mobilities.

courbes.aucun_resultat: Run a study to plot curves.
courbes.aucune_grandeur: Check quantities in the list to plot them.
courbes.etude_statique: Static study: a single instant. The values are in the Forces tab.
courbes.exporter_excel_aide: Saves the displayed quantities in an Excel workbook (.xlsx), with the charts
courbes.zone_point_mort: Passing near a dead point: the motor has little grip on the mechanism there.

resultats.vide: Run a study to obtain the wrenches of the joint actions.
resultats.entete_instant: Joint actions at t = {t} s, in the global basis. Wrench of the action of A on B, reduced at the joint point.
resultats.entete_statique: Joint actions at equilibrium, in the global basis. Wrench of the action of A on B, reduced at the joint point.

erreur.aucun_solide: The mechanism has no moving body: there is nothing to compute.
erreur.assemblage_impossible: The mechanism cannot be assembled: the joints are incompatible with the geometry (remaining gap: {residu:.3g}).
erreur.mobilite_non_pilotee: Kinematic study impossible: {mobilite} mobility(ies) are not driven by any motor. Add motors or run a dynamic study.
erreur.position_initiale_singuliere: In the initial configuration the mechanism is on a dead point and the motor law imposes a speed there: an infinite velocity would be needed. Shift the initial position slightly (Manipulate tool), give the motor a law starting at zero speed, or drive another joint.
erreur.inertie_insuffisante: Dynamic study impossible: a mobility carries no inertia. Give a mass and a moment of inertia to the bodies: {solides}.
erreur.modele_invalide: The model contains {nombre} error(s). First error, on “{objet}”: {detail}
erreur.liaison_non_geree: Joint type not handled by the solver: {type}.
erreur.trop_d_instants: Too many instants to compute ({nombre}). Increase the step or reduce the duration (maximum: {maximum}).
erreur.erreur_numerique: The computation hit a numerical problem: the data are probably out of scale or the configuration is singular ({message}).

message.mouvement_impossible: Motion impossible beyond t = {t} s: the motor law asks for a position the mechanism cannot reach (end of stroke, limit position). Computation stopped there. To turn the mechanism past a dead point, drive the crank rather than the piston, or run a dynamic study: inertia carries the mechanism through dead points.
message.configuration_singuliere: Passing close to a singular configuration around t = {t} s: results are inaccurate there.
message.hyperstatique_norme_minimale: Mechanism statically indeterminate to degree {h}: the distribution of forces among redundant joints is not unique. The minimum-norm solution is given.
message.quasi_statique: Quasi-static computation: inertia effects are neglected.
message.inertie_partielle: Some bodies have neither mass nor inertia: their dynamic effect is ignored.
message.pas_en_equilibre: The mechanism is not in equilibrium in this configuration: {mobilite} unlocked mobility(ies) in which the loads do work. Add a locking motor or search for the equilibrium position.
message.equilibre_avec_mobilite: Equilibrium verified, although {mobilite} mobility(ies) remain free.
message.integration_interrompue: Integration stopped at t = {t} s: the time step became too small (singular configuration or out-of-scale forces).
message.decollement: The normal force of joint “{liaison}” changes sign around t = {t} s: a real contact would separate at that moment (a stiffer return spring would prevent it). The model keeps the contact.
message.aucune_mobilite_libre: No free mobility: the motion is fully imposed by the joints and the motors.
message.methode_de_repli: The {methode} integrator could not finish: the computation continued with {repli}.
message.emballement_rotation: Body “{solide}” runs away (rotation speed {valeur} rad/s around t = {t} s): computation stopped. A driving torque or force is balanced by no load; add a resisting torque, damping, or a motor with imposed speed.
message.emballement_translation: Body “{solide}” runs away (speed {valeur} m/s around t = {t} s): computation stopped. A driving force is balanced by no load; add a load, damping, or a motor with imposed speed.
message.acceleration_continue: The mechanism keeps accelerating (body “{solide}” reaches {valeur} at the end): nothing balances the driving action, and forces grow with speed. This is the expected physical behaviour; for a steady state, add a load or damping.
message.depart_point_mort: Start on a dead point: at the initial time the motor has no grip on the mechanism. The crossing direction was chosen by the solver; shift the initial position slightly to impose the other one.
message.points_morts_franchis: {nombre} dead point(s) crossed, around t = {t} s: the mechanism goes through in the direction of motion. Velocities and accelerations there are derived from the positions.
message.efforts_point_mort: Near the dead point (t ≈ {t} s), motor “{moteur}” has almost no grip on the mechanism: the effort it must provide reaches {valeur}. This is the exact answer for a rigid mechanism driven this way; drive a joint that controls the motion instead, or run a dynamic study.

probleme.bati_deplace: the frame must stay at the origin.
probleme.bati_multiple: several bodies are declared as the frame.
probleme.valeur_non_finie: a numerical value is invalid or out of scale.
probleme.segment_invalide: a segment connects points that do not exist.
probleme.inertie_negative: mass and moment of inertia must be positive.
probleme.liaison_meme_solide: a joint must connect two different bodies.
probleme.solide_inconnu: reference to a body that does not exist.
probleme.point_inconnu: reference to a point that does not exist.
probleme.modele_spatial_incompatible: the spatial model does not match the joint type.
probleme.valeur_hors_bornes: a value is outside the allowed range.
probleme.ressort_meme_solide: both ends of the spring are on the same body.
probleme.action_sur_bati: a load applied to the frame has no effect.
probleme.moteur_liaison_inconnue: the motor drives a joint that does not exist.
probleme.moteur_non_pilotable: the motor drives a joint that cannot be motorised.
probleme.moteur_en_double: two motors drive the same joint.
probleme.loi_invalide: the motion law of the motor is invalid.
probleme.etude_invalide: the duration, step and tolerances of the study must be strictly positive.
probleme.cercle_invalide: a circle is not centred on a point of its body.
probleme.cercle_inconnu: a cam refers to a circle that does not exist.
probleme.option_inconnue: a joint parameter has an unknown value.
probleme.couronne_trop_petite: in an internal gear, the ring (gear B) must have more teeth than the pinion.

confirmer.detail: Your changes will be lost if you do not save them.

fichier.ouvert_avec_remarques: {nom} opened with {nombre} remark(s): see the log.
fichier.exemple_ouvert: Example “{nom}” opened as a new project.

erreur.format_inconnu: This file is not a Sikax project.
erreur.json_invalide: The file is damaged: syntax error at line {ligne}, column {colonne}.
erreur.nombre_non_fini: The file contains an invalid number (NaN or infinity).
erreur.structure_invalide: The file does not have the structure of a Sikax project.
erreur.dimension_non_geree: This project has dimension {dimension}: this version of Sikax only handles planar mechanisms.
erreur.fichier_invalide: The file contains {nombre} error(s) and was not opened.
erreur.fichier_trop_gros: The file is too large to be a Sikax project.
erreur.encodage_invalide: The file encoding is not recognised.
erreur.migration_impossible: This file was written in a format too old (version {version}) to be converted.
erreur.donnees_invalides: The project contains invalid values and cannot be saved ({message}).
erreur.module_absent: The “{module}” module needed for the export is missing from this installation.

diag.cle_en_double: the key “{cle}” appears twice; the last value is kept.
diag.nombre_en_texte: “{champ}” was written as text; it was read as a number.
diag.angle_en_degres: “{champ}” was converted from degrees to radians.
diag.booleen_invalide: “{champ}” should be true or false ({valeur}); default value used.
diag.section_en_dictionnaire: section written as a dictionary, read normally.
diag.section_invalide: this section does not have the expected form; it is ignored.
diag.format_absent: the “sikax” format marker is missing; the file is read anyway.
diag.version_invalide: unreadable version number ({valeur}); the current version is assumed.
diag.version_absente: version number missing; the current version is assumed.
diag.version_plus_recente: file written by a newer version of Sikax (format {version}, supported: {geree}); some data may be ignored.
diag.valeur_ignoree: invalid value for “{champ}”; default value used.
diag.type_etude_inconnu: unknown study type “{valeur}”; kinematic study kept.
diag.element_invalide: this element does not have the expected form.
diag.bati_multiple: several bodies are declared as the frame ({solides}); only the first is kept.
diag.bati_absent: no body is declared as the frame.
diag.bati_renomme: the frame “{ancien}” was given the identifier “S0”.
diag.bati_recale: the frame was brought back to the origin (its points were recomputed).
diag.reference_par_nom: “{champ}” refers to the object by its name (“{nom}”) instead of its identifier.
diag.solide_rejete: “{champ}”: the body “{solide}” is itself invalid (see its error).
diag.point_inconnu: “{champ}”: the point “{point}” does not exist in body “{solide}”.
diag.point_cree: a point was created on body “{solide}” to carry the joint.
diag.liaison_meme_solide: the joint connects body “{solide}” to itself.
diag.orientation_deduite: relative orientation missing; deduced from the position of the bodies.
diag.liaison_rejetee: the joint “{liaison}” is itself invalid (see its error).
diag.moteur_en_double: the joint “{liaison}” already has a motor.
diag.liaison_ouverte: the joint is not closed in the saved configuration (gap {ecart:.3g} m).
diag.mecanisme_referme: the mechanism was reassembled ({nombre} open joint(s)).
diag.fermeture_impossible: the mechanism cannot be assembled: {nombre} joint(s) remain open.
diag.fichier_migre: file converted from format {depuis} to format {vers}.
diag.encodage_inhabituel: the file is not UTF-8; it was read as {encodage}.
diag.cercle_inconnu: circle “{cercle}” does not exist in body {solide}.
diag.cercle_invalide: circle “{cercle}” of body {solide} is not centred on the joint point.
diag.cercle_deduit: cam circle not given: “{cercle}”, the only possible one, is used.
diag.fond_ignore: the background photo cannot be read: it is ignored, the rest of the project is opened.

fichier.excel_exporte: Results exported to “{nom}”: {lignes} time steps, {colonnes} quantities, with charts.
fichier.photo_importee: Photo “{nom}” imported. Calibrate the scale: click two points of a known length.

diagnostics.resume: {erreurs} error(s) and {avertissements} warning(s) found while reading the file.
diagnostics.ouvrir_quand_meme_aide: The elements in error cannot be interpreted. You can open the rest of the project: those elements will be missing, and the original file is only changed if you save.

a_propos.description: Sikax lets you draw the kinematic diagram of a planar mechanism, check its mobility and static determinacy, then compute its kinematics, statics and dynamics.
a_propos.credits: The organisation of the software is inspired by the open-source project OpenMeca (Damien André). The solver, written in Python with NumPy, is Sikax's own.

erreur.imprevue: An unexpected error occurred. Your project was not modified: save it under another name as a precaution.

modele_depart.pendule_simple_aide: Heavy bar hinged to the ground, released at rest (dynamic study)
modele_depart.came_poussoir_aide: Motor-driven eccentric cam and roller follower held by a spring
modele_depart.train_engrenages_aide: Two-stage reducer (ratio 1/9) with a resisting torque and efficiencies

detection.explication: Sikax finds the lines (orange) and circles (blue: discs, green: joints) of the photo. Tune the sensitivity until the preview matches the diagram, then create the bodies: you can correct them by hand.
detection.pivots_aide: A small circle where lines meet is taken for a joint: a revolute joint is created there.
detection.indisponible: Automatic detection needs the OpenCV module, which is missing from this installation.
detection.cree: Detected shapes added: {barres} bar(s), {disques} disc(s), {pivots} revolute joint(s).

barre.puce3: Enter, double click or right click to finish; Esc to cancel.

pivot.titre: Hinge a bar to the ground

relier.puce1: Click the first body, anywhere on its bar or disc.
relier.puce2: Click the second body: the joint goes at the first click, points are created for you. Empty space: the ground.

glissiere.puce2: Click, then drag to set the axis, in 15° steps.

cercle.puce2: Click the centre, drag to the radius.

engrenage.puce1: Gear tool (key E); the wheels need revolute joints.
engrenage.puce2: Click the first wheel, then the second (or a rack).
engrenage.puce3: Z, module, pressure angle and efficiency are set in the properties.

came.puce2: Click the cam circle, then the follower tip.
came.puce3: Knife-edge, roller or flat face: the cam can make full turns.

moteur.puce2: Click a revolute or prismatic joint; the motion law is set in the properties.

calcul.puce1: F5 runs the study chosen in the Study tab.
calcul.puce3: Curves tab: position, velocity, acceleration, forces, torques; Excel export.

photo.puce2: Click two points of a known length and type it: the photo is at scale.
photo.puce3: Trace over it, or let Sikax detect the shapes.

cours.puce1: The ? button next to an option explains the notion and opens its sheet.
cours.puce2: Course tab: statics, dynamics, torsors, gears… F1 replays this tutorial.

aide.clic_pour_le_cours: Click to open the course sheet.

etudes.nature: Kinematics: motion imposed by the motors. Statics: equilibrium. Dynamics: motion follows from the forces (Newton's second law).

methodes.methode: Method of scipy.integrate.solve_ivp. Radau (implicit, order 5) is the most robust; LSODA and DOP853 are faster on smooth motions.
methodes.precision: Relative tolerance of the integrator. 1e-8 by default; 1e-6 is enough for curves.

centre_gravite.masse: Mass of the body (kg): it gives its weight m·g and its translational inertia.
centre_gravite.position: Centre of gravity G, in the body frame: the point where the weight acts.

inertie.rubrique: Mass, centre of gravity and moment of inertia: what dynamics needs.
inertie.jz: Moment of inertia J about the axis (G, z), in kg·m². Bar: m·L²/12; disc: m·R²/2.

excentricite.cercle: Circle attached to the body: disc, cam, wheel. Its centre is a point of the body.
excentricite.excentricite: Distance between the circle centre and the body's rotation axis: an eccentric cam's stroke is 2·e.
excentricite.came: A cam turns a rotation into a reciprocating motion of the follower.
excentricite.poussoirs: Knife-edge: |CP| = R. Roller: |CP| = R + ρ. Flat face: face tangent to the circle.
excentricite.effort_normal: Force of the cam on the follower, along the contact normal. Negative: the follower would lift off.

ddl.type: Joint type: it sets the motions allowed between the two bodies (degrees of freedom).
ddl.mobilites: Relative motions allowed by the joint (ω: rotation, V: translation).

torseur.inconnues: Force components the joint can transmit: 3 minus its number of mobilities, in the plane.
torseur.liaison: Torsor of the action of A on B: resultant (X, Y) and moment N at the joint point.

isostatisme.modele_spatial: How the joint is realised in space: it changes the mechanism's real degree of hyperstatism.

couple_moteur.loi: The motor imposes the joint's angle (or displacement) as a function of time.
couple_moteur.effort: Torque (or force) the motor must provide to produce the imposed motion.
couple_moteur.couple: Torque C (N·m) applied to the body; it may depend on time, for example 5*sin(2*pi*t).

moment.force: Force components, in N. Its moment at a point A is AP ∧ F.

engrenages.rubrique: Toothed wheels: exact ratio Z₁/Z₂, tangential (Ft) and radial (Fr) tooth forces.
engrenages.nature: External: opposite directions. Internal: same direction (B is the ring). Rack: rotation → translation.
engrenages.dents: Number of teeth Z: it sets the ratio and the pitch diameter d = m·Z.
engrenages.module: Module m: tooth size. Two wheels only mesh if they have the same module.
engrenages.angle_pression: Inclination α of the line of action (usually 20°): Fr = Ft·tan α.
engrenages.rendement: η = output power / input power; 0.95 to 0.99 for a spur gear.
engrenages.formules: d = m·Z; p = π·m; a = m·(Z₁ + Z₂)/2; r = −Z₁/Z₂.
engrenages.diametre: Pitch diameter d = m·Z: the pitch circles roll without slipping.
engrenages.pas: Pitch p = π·m: distance between two teeth on the pitch circle.
engrenages.entraxe: Centre distance a = m·(Z₁ + Z₂)/2 (external), m·(Z₂ − Z₁)/2 (internal).
engrenages.efforts: Ft = 2·C/d transmits the torque; Fr = Ft·tan α pushes the wheels apart; Fn = Ft/cos α.
engrenages.couples: Torque the teeth exert on each wheel, about its centre: C = Ft·r.

cours.introduction: The mechanics notions behind Sikax. The “?” button next to an option opens the sheet that explains it.

resume.etudes: What each study computes, and when to choose it.
resume.moment: M_A(F) = AP ∧ F: a force's ability to make a body turn.
resume.couple_moteur: Torque, motor with imposed motion, power P = C·ω.
resume.torseur: Resultant and moment of an action; torsors transmitted by joints.
resume.centre_gravite: Where the weight acts; barycentre of the masses.
resume.inertie: Resistance to rotation; usual formulas and the parallel-axis theorem.
resume.excentricite: Eccentric disc, cam, follower types, lift-off.
resume.ddl: Motions allowed by joints; mobility of a mechanism.
resume.isostatisme: h = Is − Es + m: when statics is enough, and when it is not.
resume.engrenages: Module, pitch, centre distance, transmission ratio, tooth forces, efficiency.
resume.points_morts: Positions where the motor loses its grip; how to get past them.
resume.methodes: How Sikax solves the equations: Radau, augmented Lagrangian, dead points.
